edges.reason: fallback() unconditionally executes the internal _fallback() routine.
receive() unconditionally executes the internal _fallback() routine.
_fallback first invokes the _willFallback hook.
_fallback queries the implementation address via _implementation().
_fallback delegates execution through _delegate.
_delegate performs a raw delegatecall into external implementation code, transferring execution context.
Overridden _willFallback chains to super._willFallback().
Caller-controlled msg.sender is compared against the stored admin to gate the fallback path.
ifAdmin modifier authorizes external admin functions based on msg.sender.
ifAdmin gates the admin() getter.
ifAdmin gates the implementation() getter.
ifAdmin gates changeAdmin().
ifAdmin gates upgradeTo().
ifAdmin gates upgradeToAndCall().
admin() returns the value produced by _admin().
implementation() returns the value produced by the upgradeability proxy's _implementation().
changeAdmin writes the new admin through _setAdmin.
upgradeTo performs the implementation change via _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall first performs the implementation change via _upgradeTo.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls arbitrary data into the new implementation, executing external code.
_upgradeTo stores the new implementation via _setImplementation.
_setImplementation writes the implementation address into the EIP-1967 slot with assembly sstore.
_setImplementation validates the new implementation using Address.isContract.
isContract executes the extcodesize assembly check.
The constructor initializes the implementation slot via _setImplementation.
The constructor delegatecalls the supplied init data into the implementation.
AdminUpgradeabilityProxy constructor invokes the UpgradeabilityProxy base constructor.
The constructor stores the admin through _setAdmin.
_admin reads the admin address from ADMIN_SLOT with assembly sload.
_setAdmin writes the admin address into ADMIN_SLOT with assembly sstore.
_implementation reads the implementation address from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with assembly sload.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the storage location read by the implementation sload.
ADMIN_SLOT is the storage location read by the admin sload.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is the storage location written by _setImplementation.
ADMIN_SLOT is the storage location written by _setAdmin.
account parameter flows into the isContract check.
_logic parameter flows into the constructor to set the implementation.
_data parameter flows into the constructor delegatecall.
_admin parameter flows into the constructor to set the admin.
implementation parameter is the delegatecall target in _delegate.
newImplementation parameter flows into the storage write of _setImplementation.
newAdmin parameter flows into changeAdmin and onward to storage.
data parameter is forwarded to the delegatecall in upgradeToAndCall.
Local size receives the extcodesize result inside isContract.
Local slot holds IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT inside _implementation.
Local success captures the constructor delegatecall result.
Local success captures the upgradeToAndCall delegatecall result.
Local impl is returned from _implementation.
Local adm is returned from _admin.
Local slot holds IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT inside _setImplementation.
Local slot holds ADMIN_SLOT inside _setAdmin.
